title: [LOGGED OUT] Home images and product links have text for screen readers
reason: Header logo (2 imgs) has no alt attribute; the 9 product image links have an empty alt and no accessible name

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Read the alt text of all images and the accessible names of all links.
steps.saw: 14 images: 2 logo imgs (blazemeter-favicon-512x512.png) with no alt attribute; carousel imgs alt First/Second/Third slide; 9 product imgs alt="". 9 product image links (prod.html?idp_=1..9) and one href="#" link have no text

steps.text: Does every image have an alt attribute (including the header logo)?
steps.saw: The header logo img (and a second logo img in the page) has no alt attribute

steps.text: Do the product image links have an accessible name (a non-empty alt on the image)?
steps.saw: All 9 product image links contain an img with alt="" and no other text or aria-label
